pr_title: Disallow interacting with the global track state in `Player` and `Editor`
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/24271
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14816
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/24385

This PR also renames `AllowTrackAdjustments` to more understandable `ApplyModTrackAdjustments`
pr_comments: Before merging this, we should make sure to understand and adjust for https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/24385.

Regarding #24385 wouldn't locking media key like you did here right after a beatmap started loading be a fix ?

tbh doesn't feel right to be able to play around with the playback in a loading screen, but it might be a "me" issue
Please read before commenting to avoid it becoming spammy. This is already mentioned in https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/24385#issuecomment-1655044634.
@bdach if we're merging as-is, i'd want to move to `PlayerLoader` and `EditorLoader` to "cover" the other reported case. If you're happy with that then I'll just make the change.
No issue with that as far as I'm concerned

issue_context.title: The Play/Pause hotkey works separately from the Play/Pause in Editor resulting in weird interactions with each other
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Have your Play/Pause hotkey from Audio Hotkeys set to something other than spacebar (like "C")
Go to the editor of any mapset
Observe that:

- Clicking "C" when map is playing in the Editor results in a stutter resulted in an attempt of pausing the track
- Clicking "C" when map is paused in the Editor results in only the Audio being played, without the map
- Clicking "Spacebar" when map is paused in the editor but with the Audio played by the technique above, results in map being played from the point where the audio is being played


### Screenshots or videos


https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/82095491/1ba90651-e3e7-4905-b6cd-57a9fc928c2d



### Version

2023.717.0-lazer

review_comments: I guess one pain point here is that we have two levels of "global track disable" now: one being global `Beatmap.Value.Disabled` which prevents changing track, and this which prevents pausing/resuming the current track. Not sure that's necessarily bad, maybe worth an xmldoc mention.

Yeah, this one is over-arching (also disabled changing track) and should be used in most cases I guess.

The beatmap disable one seems fine to leave around for existing usages.
